import pandas as pd

# Step 1: Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/test_0.csv"
]

# Step 2: Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
source_dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    source_dfs.append(df)

# Step 3: Transform each source DataFrame to match target schema
# Target schema: ['V_GENE'] (string)
# Source schema: ['V_CALL'] (string)
# Transformation: Extract the part before '*' from V_CALL to get V_GENE

transformed_dfs = []
for df in source_dfs:
    # Extract V_GENE by splitting V_CALL at '*'
    df['V_GENE'] = df['V_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    # Select only the V_GENE column
    transformed_df = df[['V_GENE']]
    transformed_dfs.append(transformed_df)

# Step 4: Combine all transformed DataFrames (union)
target_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Step 5: Remove duplicates if any (since target examples are unique V_GENE values)
target_df = target_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Step 6: Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
